title: Stressed Banks? Evidence from the Largest-Ever Supervisory Review
authors: Puriya Abbassi; Rajkamal Iyer; José-Luis Peydró; Paul E. Soto
eligible_reason: Single event date: dummyaqr = 1 for Oct-Dec 2013 (ECB asset quality review announcement), dummyaudit = Jan-Jun 2014, dummyre = Jul-Sep 2014, common to all banks (ReadMe.do lines 99-111); reviewed = bank was part of the AQR. Tables 2-8 regress security holdings / credit on dummyaqr x reviewed (often x safe, x exposure) with bank-security, firm-bank and month FE; several columns are triple differences or use continuous exposure (rb_share50, rb_exp_2013). One adoption cohort, so not staggered. Data are confidential Bundesbank security and credit register data available only through the RDSC; none shipped.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. Table 2: reghdfe log_loan c.dummyaqr##c.reviewed, absorb(firmbankFE timeFE) cluster(firmbankFE) on +/- 3 months around the Oct 2013 announcement. Tables 7-8 add AQR-compliance and post-AQR period dummies (same dates for all banks). Tables 9-11 firm-level real effects with continuous exposure to reviewed banks x aqr period.
data_files_note: Bundesbank RDSC restricted project 2016_0083; package ships code, logs and table outputs only.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Single AQR announcement date common to all banks; no data shipped.
